original_test_intent: Read one authorized Chassis member selected from the intended BMC's Chassis collection, validate exact resource identity and approved inventory/health metadata, and retain redacted member evidence without changing platform state.
original_method: Resolve `{ChassisId}` from a validated collection link, use curl/jq rather than ipmitool, replace embedded credentials/TLS bypass with trusted access, and validate the returned Chassis schema and exact @odata identity.
manual_activity: The platform/BMC owner authorizes the selected collection member, trusted Redfish credential, and retention/redaction rules for serial, asset tag, location, health, model, part number and OEM links.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Authorized exact member @odata.id from validated Chassis collection
Field-level redaction policy and secure raw evidence location
safety_requirements: Do not accept a guessed ChassisId
Do not expose credentials or Authorization
No chassis mutation or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Validate collection and select one approved member link
Issue one bounded GET to that exact link
Compare approved identity/health fields to baseline
Export redacted member report and no-mutation audit
engineer_actions: Authorize exact member and disclosure scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The parameter guard and member URI fit the source, but ipmitool is not the dependency, the ID is not cryptographically bound to a collection link, and `-k`/basic-auth plus missing HTTP/schema/identity checks remain unsafe.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Using curl/jq with trusted TLS and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, GET exactly the owner-approved @odata.id from the validated Chassis collection, require exact identity/Chassis schema, compare approved fields and export redacted evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The one-member GET and 15/10 timing remain; no ChassisId, expected identity, health or asset value is inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the collection response as the member authority, then verify the selected Chassis resource as a bounded inventory/health object without expanding its power, sensors, thermal or action links.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative member provenance, trusted transport, schema/baseline validation and disclosure containment.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The collection proves topology; this case validates one member's own identity/health/inventory fields, while subordinate Sensors/Thermal/Power resources require their separate cases.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Serial, part, asset and location fields are sensitive; OEM links and composite chassis models may require a platform profile to distinguish enclosure, board and module members.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK is equivalent only if it uses the exact collection-supplied link, preserves certificate binding, avoids automatic link expansion and exposes the same identity/schema/raw evidence for audit.
expected_evidence: Immutable BMC endpoint and certificate/trust result
Validated Chassis collection and selected exact member link
curl/jq/schema-tool and credential-provider versions without secrets
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw response hash
Redacted member report and no-link-expansion audit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The authoritative item, member placeholder, GET path and criteria consistently describe a Chassis member read. DeepSeek's ipmitool dependency is a reference-review error rather than a Master contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The resource type and operation are explicit. Collection-derived member identity, trust, credentials, schema, expected fields and redaction are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Corrects the package contract and makes the ChassisId an authorized collection link with exact identity/schema and non-expanding redacted evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Chassis identifiers are implementation-defined and may represent enclosures, boards or modules; a familiar literal cannot establish the intended target. The exact @odata.id must come from the validated collection and the member response must match it. Because a Chassis resource links to actions and subordinate telemetry, the client must not auto-expand those resources in this case. Member inventory fields are separately sensitive and need field-level redaction even though the operation is read-only.
